title: Here's me...
content: My name is Dmitry Zhukov. I am an optimistic, open and driven person with many passions - music, fitness, comedy, philosophy, sci-fi and role-playing games, but most importantly - software development. I am a design-minded frontend engineer with back-end skills specializing in component architecture, UI systems and developer experience. Over the last three years, I've shipped features and infrastructure improvements across enterprise applications, a scientific visualization platform and design systems.
